hero.headline: Building with rigor, equipping with standards, maintaining with passion, <gold>renovating with excellence</gold> and committing with heart.
hero.subtitle: We are a cornerstone of your projects — the perfect alliance of BTP expertise, cutting-edge equipment and human commitment in service of your investments.

ceo.headline: A vision. A legacy. A commitment.
ceo.quote: At 2HNOUR SARL, we are deeply convinced that every infrastructure represents far more than a simple assembly of materials: IT EMBODIES A VISION, CARRIES AN AMBITION AND PAVES THE WAY FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT. Building is a responsibility. Preserving and transmitting it is our commitment. This is how we build, today, the legacy of tomorrow.

cta_section.subtitle: Our teams support you from initial study to delivery, with rigor and transparency.

about.meta_desc: Our history, vision and values — Excellence, Integrity, Responsibility, Safety, Sustainability.
about.hero_title: A signature of excellence for Cameroonian construction.
about.hero_subtitle: Since our founding, 2HNOUR SARL has supported public institutions and private players in construction, rehabilitation and preservation of their built heritage.
about.history_headline: Building with conviction. Serving with consistency.
about.history_p1: Founded in Yaoundé, 2HNOUR SARL has established itself as a reference partner for public administrations, institutions and private players seeking integrated BTP expertise.
about.history_p2: Under the leadership of CEO Mme Virginie Hanna FADIMATOU, our company brings together engineers, technicians and craftsmen around a shared standard: delivering durable, aesthetic and perfectly maintained structures.
about.history_p3: We believe that a well-designed and well-maintained infrastructure is a lever for development — for its users, for the nation and for the environment.
about.vision_headline: Building the future with clarity and determination.
about.vision_lead: Our vision and mission guide every decision and every project to build modern, durable and high-impact infrastructure for Cameroon.
about.vision_title: Become the reference for integrated BTP in Central Africa.
about.vision_text: We aim to uphold the highest standards of construction, maintenance and heritage management, cultivating the pride of work well done and transmitted.
about.mission_title: Offer a complete, coherent and responsible service.
about.mission_text: From design to maintenance, we support every project with unwavering commitment to quality, safety, ethics and environmental respect.
about.values_headline: The principles that forge our identity

about.solidarity_text: Beyond construction and engineering, 2HNOUR SARL actively invests in local communities: school rehabilitation, access to clean water, electrification of orphanages and integration of young Cameroonian talent.

contact_page.adv_1: Privileged access to major projects: Synergies on institutional and private tenders of significant scale.
contact_page.adv_2: Expertise sharing & Innovation: Technical collaboration for premium execution standards.
contact_page.adv_3: Administrative & financial security: Rigorous contractual guarantees and budget transparency.
contact_page.adv_4: Enhanced visibility: Joint promotion among our key accounts and institutional networks.
contact_page.requirements_subtitle: The strict standards and ethical criteria 2HNOUR adheres to:
contact_page.req_1: Strict regulatory compliance: Rigorous adherence to BTP, environmental and occupational safety standards.
contact_page.req_2: Quality & Deadline Charter: Obligation of results and mandatory compliance with validated schedules.
contact_page.req_3: Ethics & Transparency: Zero-tolerance policy on corruption and exemplary governance.
contact_page.req_4: Confidentiality: Full protection of strategic data and trade secrets of our joint projects.

renover.short: Full rehabilitation, facade refurbishment, structural reinforcement and modernization of existing installations.
